title: Round 5 stream D: the director board, labs.html#director, the story's timeline from the content tables, and the list of what lives only in code
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, note 3: 'A visual timeline of all the sectors and triggers: when KO-TECH prints, when the cutscenes play, a full director board.' Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-round-5-ten-notes-design.md, stream D (a lab tab, a pure domain module turning the tables into rows, no td-tab change, the data staying where it is). Branch round-5-director off fbe323c0, unpushed.
outcome: labs.html#director (src/labs/director-tab.js; drawer: DEV, the world row): columns left to right, the six tutorial chapters (TUTORIAL n/6, their beats), S1 .. BOTH WALLS, THE DESCENT, THE ENDING, ENDLESS; the door's range 7..8 drawn as a shaded band with its rule ('the door at 7 if everything is unlocked when sector 6 begins: every landing site's part home, Isao's programme printed but for the passable steps; else at 8'); AT 7 / AT 8 redraws the arc (at 8: S6 a held SECTOR 6, S7 THE CANYON AGAIN .. S10 BOTH WALLS). Six lanes: SECTORS (each row's name, shape and bodies, new unlock, breaches, threat, brief id; the omens, the feast, the canyon's numbers), PRINTS (the 16 programme steps at their when: 4 in ROTOR at rotor-ready, the solar array in EXPEDITION, bays/HUGIN/board/garage S1 at the lull, radar S2 with its close-up, assembly/armory S2, farm S3, chips and the launcher S4 after two manned passes, the back gate at the door, passable; plus Isao's missile from S6), DROPS & COMPANIONS (C-07 at expedition + 20 s quiet, RECKON K9 at the radar + 3 days, REINFORCEMENTS CALLED at the radar, the FEIDS-26 drop spanning the radar to THE ARENA with 'uplink + 8 days, THE ARENA's start at the latest', DAY 42 across every sector: 'day 42 is 21 min of game clock at 30 s a day; past day 48 at the next free moment'), CUTSCENES (every shot id at its trigger with its file), ISAO (93-94 of 118 briefs in 20-21 expandable count cards, voiced marked, code-placed marked), JUMPS (the 13 STORY_JUMPS as links into the game, each at the column it opens on). A hover gives every source as file:line, the line found in the served file at load (src/domain/director-board.js lineOf; 249-250 sources in 34 files, all found), the rule and the raw when. src/domain/director-board.js is pure (tables in as parameters); the moments that start in code are src/content/director.js (DIRECTOR_SHOTS, DIRECTOR_CODE_BRIEFS), each with a { file, find } that test/director-board.mjs checks against the source, and the test also scans the source for every startShot / shot / dive id so a new cutscene cannot be missed (it found downdash and victory on its first run). Two rules moved out of src/fx/sector-run.js into src/domain/sectors.js so the board reads the game's own: sectorBriefId (the sector's brief) and openingDoorAt (the door of a ?skip=defence&sector=N run), behaviour pinned by the test against the old expressions. COULD NOT PLACE FROM DATA, the list for the owner: (1) the door's sector itself (backDoorNext's rule over sector-run's unlocked(): code); (2) 15 shots started in code: arrival, arrivalTalk (the landing), sitesTour (after the arrival), takeControl (each scripted seat hand-over), rollout (the Stålheart stands), isaoTalk (the study), sol88Launch (the launcher stands), descentLook (BOTH WALLS held), diorama (the ending), breach (each new sinkhole group, a corner feed unless &cuts=dive), backdoor (the mouth falls), downdash (a hull lost), and the design's boss and canyon, which are no camera shot at all (THE MOTHER card and the forced seat; the glide into SOL-82's seat); only antennaPrint, petPrint x2, feidsDrop and discoReveal are placed from data; (3) 6 shots outside a run: showcaseGround (?intro=1), mechLook, cargoView, backview (harness hooks), reveal and victory (the campaign board); (4) 35 briefs placed from code (story-beats' tutorial lines, gunship_overhead, stalheart_stands, the expedition's lines, gunship_pass, laser_pass, sol88_charge/online, back_door, the eight arena lines); (5) 24-25 briefs on no timeline: event-driven warnings (gate_*, heart_*, array_*, old_breach, gate_mended), codex and early lines (arrival, stalheart, harvest, motive, printer, relay, biomass, gates), part_home, chain_lore, board_lead, isao_repair, sector_hold at the door 7 (no held sector exists then), and sol88_away, which no file references. Findings for the owner: the drawer's DESCENT jump (?skip=defence&sector=9&descent=1, titled 'BOTH WALLS with the cave') opens sector 9 as THE BACK DOOR with the door at 9 by sector-run's opening rule, not BOTH WALLS (left as it is: not this stream's to change); no programme step, perk or table is named KO-TECH, so the board cannot show it by that name.
alternatives: Line numbers written into the code map by hand: rot with every edit by the other streams; the board reads the served files and finds each `find` text instead, and the test fails when a text leaves its file.

Days mapped onto sectors (a minutes-per-sector estimate): days run on the clock and a sector's length depends on play; the day-gated items sit in their own lane with the day rule written on them and a dashed edge.
113+ brief rows in the ISAO lane: one count card per column instead, expandable, as the design asked.
The code map inside the domain module: content holds data, the domain takes it as a parameter like every other table (add-module).
